units.source_text: 正夫人的父亲式部卿亲王闻知此事，说道：“事已如此，将来他把那个漂亮女人迎进来，

en.t: When the principal wife's father, Prince Shikibukyo, heard of this, he said, "Since matters have come to this, if he brings that beautiful woman into the house,

units.source_text: 大加宠爱，而教我的女儿屈居在角落里，岂不被人耻笑？

en.t: lavishes affection on her, and makes my daughter live pushed away in a corner, will she not be laughed at by everyone?

units.source_text: 只要我一息尚存，我的女儿就没有必要含羞忍辱地依人篱下。”

en.t: As long as I still draw breath, my daughter has no need to endure shame and humiliation while depending on another household."

units.source_text: 便把邸宅东面的厢屋加以整饰，想把女儿接回家来。

en.t: He therefore had the east wing of his residence repaired and prepared, intending to bring his daughter back home.

units.source_text: 女儿则以为虽然是娘家，但既是已嫁之身，而重新回来依靠父母，终非长策。

en.t: The daughter, however, thought that although it was her natal home, she was already a married woman, and returning to depend on her parents again could not be a lasting solution.

units.source_text: 烦恼之余，心情更恶，便病倒了。

en.t: Worn down by distress, her spirits grew even worse, and she fell ill.

units.source_text: 此人本性柔顺，心地善良，态度天真烂漫。

en.t: By nature she was gentle and compliant, kindhearted, and innocent in manner.

units.source_text: 但因心病不时发作，以致常常被人疏远。

en.t: But because her mental illness flared up from time to time, people often kept their distance from her.

units.source_text: 她房中器物零乱，灰尘堆积，没有一块清净之处，满目凄凉之色。

en.t: The furnishings in her room were in disorder, dust had piled up, not one spot was clean, and everything looked desolate.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将看惯了玉鬘所居琼楼玉宇，看了她的房间觉得不堪入目。

en.t: General Higekuro, used to the splendid palace-like rooms where Tamakazura lived, found her room painful to look at.

units.source_text: 但因长年夫妻之情尚在，心中觉得非常可怜。

en.t: Yet the feeling of many years as husband and wife still remained, and in his heart he pitied her deeply.

units.source_text: 对她说道：“即使是结婚数日、交情极浅的夫妻，凡是良家出身的人，

en.t: He said to her, "Even when a couple has been married only a few days and their bond is still shallow, if they come from good families,

units.source_text: 都能互相体谅，相与白头偕老。

en.t: they can show consideration for each other and grow old together.

units.source_text: 你身体很不健康，因此我有欲说的话，难于向你启口。

en.t: Your health is very poor, and so even when I have something I wish to say, it is hard for me to bring it up.

units.source_text: 你我不是多年相契的老夫妻么？

en.t: Are you and I not an old married couple who have understood each other for many years?

units.source_text: 你的病状异乎寻常，但我一向对你照顾周到，含容隐忍，直到今朝。

en.t: Your illness is unusual, but I have always cared for you attentively, bearing and overlooking much down to this very day.

units.source_text: 但愿你也善始善终，对我勿萌厌弃之念。

en.t: I only hope that you too will remain faithful from beginning to end and not let any thought of rejecting me arise.

units.source_text: 我常对你说：我们已有子女，在无论何种情况之下，我决不疏远你。

en.t: I have often told you that we already have children, and under no circumstances will I ever cast you aside.

units.source_text: 你却怀着妇人之见，一直无缘无故地怨恨我。

en.t: Yet you cling to a woman's narrow suspicions and have gone on resenting me for no reason.

units.source_text: 在你尚未确知我的真心期间，难怪你要恨我。

en.t: While you still did not truly know my heart, it was understandable that you hated me.

units.source_text: 但现在请你暂时任我所为，且看结果如何。

en.t: But now please leave things to me for a while and see how they turn out.

units.source_text: 岳父闻知我的事情，愤怒之余，断然地要把你接回娘家去，这样做其实太轻率了。

en.t: Your father heard about my affair and, in his anger, firmly decided to take you back to your natal home, but that is really too rash.

units.source_text: 不知道他是真有决心呢，还是暂用这话来惩诫我？”

en.t: I do not know whether he is truly resolved, or whether he is only using those words for the moment to admonish me."

units.source_text: 说到这里笑起来。

en.t: Having said this, he laughed.

units.source_text: 夫人听了这番话非常懊恼。

en.t: The lady was deeply distressed when she heard these words.

units.source_text: 多年在邸内当差而形似侧室的侍女木工君、中将君等人听了，也各自怀着愤愤不平之感。

en.t: The attendants Mokunokimi, Chujogimi, and others, who had served in the residence for years and were almost like secondary wives, heard this too and each felt indignant.

units.source_text: 可巧夫人这几天精神恢复正常，她哭得非常伤心，答道：“你骂我昏聩，笑我乖僻，我罪属应得。

en.t: As it happened, the lady's mind had returned to normal over these few days, and she wept bitterly as she answered, "If you scold me as muddled and laugh at me as perverse, I deserve the blame.

units.source_text: 但你涉及我父亲之事，被他听到了叫我何以为颜？

en.t: But if my father were to hear you speak of him in this way, how could I face him?

units.source_text: 为了我这不幸之身，使父亲受到了轻率的讥评！

en.t: Because of my unfortunate self, my father has been subjected to the charge of acting rashly.

units.source_text: 你那勾当，我早已闻知，不是今天初次听到，所以不会悲伤的。”

en.t: As for what you have been doing, I heard of it long ago; today is not the first time, so I will not grieve over it."

units.source_text: 说着背转身去，姿态优美可爱。

en.t: As she said this she turned her back, and her bearing was graceful and lovely.

units.source_text: 这位夫人身材本来小巧，由于经常患病，更见消瘦憔悴，有弱不禁风之状。

en.t: This lady had always been petite, and because she was often ill, she looked still thinner and more wasted, as though she could scarcely withstand a breeze.

units.source_text: 头发本来既密且长，现在疏疏落落，好像被人分了一部分去。

en.t: Her hair had once been thick and long, but now it was sparse and uneven, as if someone had taken part of it away.

units.source_text: 加之栉沐久缺，泪雨常沾，更觉十分可怜。

en.t: Since she had long neglected combing and washing it, and it was often wet with tears, she seemed all the more pitiable.

units.source_text: 她本来就没有娇艳之相。

en.t: She had never possessed a dazzling, seductive beauty.

units.source_text: 但酷肖乃父，容貌昳丽；只是病中不暇修饰，所以全无华丽之色。

en.t: But she closely resembled her father and had a beautiful face; only, being ill and unable to attend to her appearance, she had no splendor at all.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将对她说道：“我怎敢讥评岳父？

en.t: General Higekuro said to her, "How could I dare to criticize your father?

units.source_text: 你不可说这种丧失礼貌而有损名誉的话！”

en.t: You must not say such discourteous words that damage his honor."

units.source_text: 他用这话安慰她，又说：“近来我常去的那个地方，非常豪华，有似琼楼玉宇。

en.t: He comforted her with these words, then continued, "The place I have often gone to lately is extremely splendid, like a jeweled palace.

units.source_text: 像我这样陌生而粗率的人在那里进进出出，常恐这样那样地受人注目，颇有痛苦之感。

en.t: When someone as unfamiliar and rough as I am goes in and out there, I am constantly afraid of attracting attention in one way or another, and it is rather painful.

units.source_text: 为此想把她接回家来，以求放心。

en.t: For that reason I want to bring her home here, so that I may be at ease.

units.source_text: 太政大臣在当今之世，声望高贵无比，更不待言；他家里万事十全其美，教人看了自感羞惭。

en.t: It goes without saying that the Grand Minister's prestige in the present age is incomparably noble; everything in his household is so perfect that seeing it makes one feel ashamed.

units.source_text: 我们这里倘有家丑外扬，被他闻知，实在太难为情，并且对他不起。

en.t: If any family disgrace from our house were to become known outside and reach his ears, it would be terribly embarrassing and would wrong him as well.

units.source_text: 所以那人迁来之后，务请你与她和睦相处。

en.t: So after that woman moves here, I earnestly ask you to live with her in harmony.

units.source_text: 你即使回娘家去，我也不会忘记你。

en.t: Even if you return to your natal home, I will not forget you.

units.source_text: 无论怎样，我俩的情爱今后决不会断绝。

en.t: Whatever happens, the affection between us will never be severed from now on.

units.source_text: 但你倘断然离我而去，则在你势必为世人所取笑，在我亦当受轻薄的讥评。

en.t: But if you resolutely leave me, then you will surely be mocked by the world, and I too will be criticized as frivolous and heartless.

units.source_text: 因此请你勿忘多年来夫妻之情，和我长共相守，互相照拂。”

en.t: Therefore, please do not forget the affection of our many years as husband and wife, but stay with me always and care for each other."

units.source_text: 夫人听了他这番劝慰的话，答道：“你的薄情，我毫不介意。

en.t: After hearing these consoling words from him, the lady replied, "I do not mind your coldness at all.

units.source_text: 我所悲的，是父亲为了我这异于常人的疾病之身而愁叹，今又为了世人笑我被丈夫遗弃而伤心。

en.t: What grieves me is that my father has lamented this diseased body of mine, so unlike other people's, and now he must suffer again because the world will laugh that I have been abandoned by my husband.

units.source_text: 我很对他不起，有何面目回家去见父亲呢？

en.t: I have wronged him deeply; with what face could I go home and meet my father?

units.source_text: 你说起太政大臣家的紫夫人，她对我并非外人。

en.t: You speak of Lady Murasaki in the Grand Minister's household, but she is no stranger to me.

units.source_text: 此人幼时离开父亲，在外生长起来，现在却做了那人的义母而以我丈夫为女婿。

en.t: She left her father in childhood and was raised elsewhere, yet now she has become that woman's adoptive mother and has taken my husband as a son-in-law.

units.source_text: 父亲颇感不快，但我也毫不介意。

en.t: My father feels considerable displeasure at this, but I myself do not mind it at all.

units.source_text: 我只要静观你的行动。”

en.t: I will simply watch your actions quietly."

units.source_text: 髭黑大将说：“这真是知情达理之言！

en.t: General Higekuro said, "Those are truly reasonable and understanding words.

units.source_text: 但你那毛病发作起来，痛苦的事情又出来了。

en.t: But when that illness of yours flares up, painful matters arise again.

units.source_text: 今回的事，紫夫人并不知道。

en.t: Lady Murasaki knows nothing about this matter.

units.source_text: 太政大臣把她当作千金小姐一般宠爱，她岂肯顾问我这种鄙夫俗子之事？

en.t: The Grand Minister cherishes her like a precious young lady; why would she ever concern herself with the affairs of a vulgar fellow like me?

units.source_text: 她并不以义母自居。

en.t: She does not act as if she were an adoptive mother.

units.source_text: 你们凭空乱猜，被她听到了不好意思啊！”

en.t: If she heard you all making baseless guesses, it would be terribly awkward."

units.source_text: 他在夫人房中住了一天，同她谈了许多话。

en.t: He spent the day in the lady's room and talked with her at length.
